# OASIS UBL 2.1 schemas

This directory vendors the normative Invoice schema and its common-schema dependencies from the
OASIS UBL 2.1 OS release:

`https://docs.oasis-open.org/ubl/os-UBL-2.1/xsd/`

The files are unmodified. Tests only flatten the Invoice schema's `../common/` locations while
loading the files into the validator's in-memory filesystem. Each XSD retains its OASIS copyright
and release header.
